steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.state.settings.autoQuality=false; g.setQuality('high'); g.dpr=1; g.renderer.setPixelRatio(1); g.resize(); g.bears.directorT=9999; const we=g.env.weather; we.cloud=0.25; we.cloudTarget=0.25; we.rain=0; we.rainTarget=0; we.timer=9999; g.hud.firstShown=-1000; g.hud.hint('',0); g.hud.show(false); __rhf.god(true); g.env.timeScale=0; g.player.tool='none'; g.viewmodel.setTool('none'); g.wildlife.threatPos=()=>({x:1e7,z:1e7,loud:0}); const W=g.world; window.__stand=async(tx,tz,dist,pitch,hour,label)=>{g.env.setTime(hour); let best=null; for(let k=0;k<48;k++){ const a=k/48*6.283; const x=tx+Math.cos(a)*dist, z=tz+Math.sin(a)*dist; if(!W.inBounds(x,z,10)) continue; const w=W.waterAt(x,z); if(w&&w.depth>0.05) continue; if(g.colliders.circlesNear(x,z,2).some(c=>Math.hypot(c.x-x,c.z-z)<c.r+0.8)) continue; const sc=W.slopeAt(x,z)*10+Math.abs(W.heightAt(x,z)-W.heightAt(tx,tz))*0.3; if(!best||sc<best.sc) best={x,z,sc}; } if(!best) return label+': no spot'; g.player.place(best.x,best.z,Math.atan2(-(tx-best.x),-(tz-best.z))); g.player.pitch=pitch; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2000)); g.env.setTime(hour); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,4000)); const vis=Object.entries(g.insects.layers).filter(([k,m])=>m.visible).map(([k])=>k).join(' '); return label+' at '+hour+' h, sun '+g.env.sunElevation.toFixed(1)+' deg, showing: '+(vis||'none'); }; window.__best=(near,rad,score)=>{let best=null; for(let dz=-rad;dz<=rad;dz+=6) for(let dx=-rad;dx<=rad;dx+=6){ const x=near.x+dx, z=near.z+dz; if(!W.inBounds(x,z,30)) continue; const s=score(x,z); if(s>-1e8&&(!best||s>best.s)) best={x,z,s}; } return best; }; window.__flowers=(x,z)=>{ let s=0; for(let j=-2;j<=2;j++) for(let i=-2;i<=2;i++){ const k=W.cellIndex(x+i*3,z+j*3); s+=W.flower[k]; } const w=W.waterAt(x,z); if(w&&w.depth>0) return -1e9; return s/25-W.slopeAt(x,z)*300; }; return 'lights '+g.props.nightLights.length})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const W=g.world; const b=__best(W.place('bend'),240,(x,z)=>{ const w=W.waterAt(x,z); if(!w||w.depth<0.3||w.depth>1.2) return -1e9; return 1; }); return await __stand(b.x,b.z,7,-0.14,13,'river')})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const W=g.world; const b=__best(W.place('moose'),200,(x,z)=>{ const w=W.waterAt(x,z); if(!w||w.depth<0.2||w.depth>1.0) return -1e9; return 1; }); return await __stand(b.x,b.z,6,0.02,21.7,'dusk')})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const L=g.props.nightLights[0]; const ia=g.props.interactions.find(i=>i.id==='cabin'); g.env.setTime(0.5); g.player.place(ia.x,ia.z,Math.atan2(-(L.x-ia.x),-(L.z-ia.z))); g.player.pitch=Math.atan2(L.y-(g.player.pos.y+1.7),Math.hypot(L.x-ia.x,L.z-ia.z)); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2000)); g.env.setTime(0.5); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,5000)); return 'night on the cabin porch, moths '+g.insects.layers.moth.visible+', sun '+g.env.sunElevation.toFixed(1)})()
